notes: Status bar clock is now synchronized in real time, refreshing every second with full date and time
The clock shares the same source as logs (local system time) and can be used as the test record time baseline
Added serial hot-plug: device list auto-reffreshes on plug/unplug with 500ms debounce
Added auto-reconnect: a connected device is reconnected by VID/PID after reinsertion; manual disconnect disables it
Hardened repeated hot-plug stability: rapid plug cycles inside the debounce window rebuild the stale handle, and reconnect waits for in-flight probing to finish to avoid port contention
Added multi-language switching with runtime hot-swap between Chinese and English
Improved UI refresh; switching language keeps connections and data
Added multi-serial, TCP and MQTT protocol framework
Added customizable log directory with reset to default
First official release with multi-serial communication and logging
